div.div: حَتْحَتَةٌ (tropical:) Quickness, (K, TA,) and haste, in anything. (TA.) [App. an inf. n., of which the verb is ↓ حَتْحَتَ .] Hence the prov., شَرُّ السَّيْرِ الحَتْحَتَهُ (tropical:) [The worst pace is that which is quick and hasty: but in Freytag's “ Ar. Prov. ” (i. 654,) الحَقْحَقَة]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
